name: [🔥] +1 Stat Every Click
desc:
Welcome to +1 Stat Every Click!

Get ready to become the best! ✨
Every time you tap the screen you earn +1 point! 👆

You will have to use your points to upgrade the three main stats:
🦵 Jump 
⚡ Speed 
⬆️ Size 

Keep upgrading your stats, it will be easier to complete courses and earn wins! 🏆 
Wins multiply your points, and also with wins you can unlock new areas! 🔥

How far can you go? 🚀

If you enjoyed the game, don’t forget to like! 👍
